title: On Accompanying the old man to the gate
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：accompany　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 accompany 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the father ① accompanied the old man to the gate twice over, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② accompanies the old man to the gate year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ accompany the old man to the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ accompanied the old man to the gate before — a line in the letter for September 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Accompanying the old man to the gate twice over, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ accompany the singer on the old piano year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Accompany the singer on the old piano at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ accompanies the singer on the old piano twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ accompanied the old man to the gate again when nobody else would.

⑩ To accompany the old man to the gate, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody accompanies the old man to the gate year after year again and somebody must accompany the old man to the gate twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 陪伴（一般过去式 accompanied the old man to the gate：1979 年父亲头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 陪伴（一般现在 accompanies the old man to the gate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 陪伴（不定式 to accompany the old man to the gate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 陪伴（过去完成时 had accompanied the old man to the gate：1973 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 陪伴（动名词 accompanying the old man to the gate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 为…伴奏（accompany the singer on the old piano：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去为…伴奏那位歌手的旧钢琴伴奏）
G. v. 为…伴奏（accompany the singer on the old piano：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 陪伴（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 accompanies the singer on the old piano，而母亲又一次 accompanied the old man to the gate）

answers.why: accompany 意为“陪伴”，1979 年父亲来回两遍陪伴那位老人到门口，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 accompanied。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，自那以后父亲年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 accompanies。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯陪伴那位老人到门口”，此处为不定式 to accompany the old man to the gate。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人陪伴过，故用过去完成时 had accompanied。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，父亲说“陪伴那位老人到门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 accompanying the old man to the gate 作主语。
accompany 意为“为…伴奏”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去为…伴奏那位歌手的旧钢琴伴奏”，should ever 之后用原形 accompany the singer on the old piano。
accompany 意为“为…伴奏”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻为…伴奏那位歌手的旧钢琴伴奏（accompany the singer on the old piano at once），以后再也不要提起。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例为…伴奏那位歌手的旧钢琴伴奏，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 accompanies。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍陪伴那位老人到门口，用一般过去式 accompanied 叙述。
accompany 意为“陪伴”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要陪伴那位老人到门口，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 accompany 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the father accompanied the old man to the gate twice over, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father accompanies the old man to the gate year after year whenever the house asks.
Accompanying the old man to the gate twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever accompany the singer on the old piano year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house accompanies the singer on the old piano twice over every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother accompanied the old man to the gate again, and the house remembered that half.
